subject: HA advisory: packaging options, escalation coverage & pricing

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@atlascloud.co>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood HA offering — quick packaging question

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is pulling together the vendor comparison and I had a couple of specific questions about your HA / premium support packaging before we move to legal:

1) Do you offer a committed-availability discount if we buy a 12-month reserved capacity + premium SLA (99.99%)? If so, what levels of discount are typical at $50k/mo, $100k/mo, and $250k/mo ARR run-rate?

2) On escalation coverage: we need guaranteed 24x7 follow-the-sun escalation for Sev1s with named-engineer involvement and a 1-hour response window. Is that included in the top-tier pack or billed as an add-on?

3) Deliverables for procurement: sample SOW, list of regional failover assurances, and any DocuSign-ready terms for an exec escalation clause.

Can you send something succinct we can share with legal and finance?

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager
AtlasCloud
Attachment: (none in this message)

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 09:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood HA offering — quick packaging question

Sofia,

Appreciate the clear list — great questions. Quick answers below, and I attached a short pricing summary + SOW stub for procurement.

Summary answers (high level):
- Committed-availability discount: yes. For a 12-month reserved capacity + premium SLA we typically offer:
  • ~$50k/mo: 7% MSRP discount + 30% discount on priority on-call hours
  • ~$100k/mo: 12% MSRP discount + 40% priority hours
  • >=$250k/mo: 18% MSRP discount + negotiable retainer (we can discuss staged credits)

- Escalation coverage: Our "CriticalCare" tier includes 24x7 named-engineer escalation, on-call handoffs, and a 1-hour response SLO for Sev1. By default the named-engineer is on a rotation; for guaranteed single-named coverage we offer an "Assigned SME" add-on (premium).

- Deliverables: attached HA_Pack_Pricing_v2.pdf and Redwood_Support_SOW.docx (SOW is editable and includes an escalation appendix). Also adding a DocuSign draft link in a follow-up once scope is locked.

If you want, we can put a one-pager that compares the pure "CriticalCare" pack vs. a Retainer+Assigned-SME hybrid (shows cost, response SLO, and escalation path).

Next step suggestion: if procurement wants numbers for the 3 bands above I can convert them into a 1-page commercial term sheet and include a proposed escalation annex for legal. Do you want that today or early next week?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Attachment: HA_Pack_Pricing_v2.pdf, Redwood_Support_SOW.docx

Grace — thanks, useful. A few clarifications from procurement and the technical team (quoted below):

On discounting: procurement is asking whether the discount bands above are net of consumption credits and whether we can get a modest additional discount if AtlasCloud commits to a 12-month minimum spend and provides a 30% prepayment. Our target is to keep total TCO predictable.

On escalation: engineering wants the 1-hour response for Sev1 to include initial triage + commitment to a mitigation plan within 4 hours. And they want a named-engineer handoff within 12 hours for follow-through. Can you confirm those timelines?

On contract terms: legal flagged an "exec escalation" clause — they want a single-point exec contact at Redwood for P1 incidents (escalate within 2 hours) and a documented runbook for cross-region failover. Is that something Redwood will accept as a contractual annex?

We need the commercial term sheet and SOW to circulate to legal by end of next week. Also, finance will need a DocuSign-ready term sheet if we can get to agreed numbers.

For reference: procurement contact is procurement@atlascloud.co (cc'd in their internal tracker).

Thanks — Sofia

Sofia / AtlasCloud procurement team,

Thanks — we can meet your timing. Quick commitments from our side and an outline of the concession we can offer if AtlasCloud signs a 12-month reserved capacity agreement with 30% prepayment:

Commercial concession (one-time offer):
- Commitment: 12-month reserved capacity + CriticalCare premium SLA (99.99%) with 30% prepayment.
- Net discount: 15% off MSRP at the $100k/mo band (applies if committed monthly spend >= $100k). This replaces the standard 12% listed earlier.
- Priority on-call credits: 50% discount on priority hours for the first 3 months; afterwards we revert to contracted rate.
- Assigned SME: complimentary for the first 90 days (subject to renewal terms). After the trial, Assigned SME is available as a paid add-on.

Service-level commitments we will include in the annex:
- Sev1 initial response: within 1 hour (acknowledge + initial triage).
- mitigation plan: documented within 4 hours.
- Named-engineer handoff: named contact and ownership transfer within 12 hours.
- Exec escalation: Redwood will provide a single exec escalation contact with a guaranteed 2-hour acknowledgement and 8-hour senior leadership touchpoint for P1s.
- Cross-region runbook: included in the SOW annex; we will include failover steps and test cadence.

Conditions: the concession above requires a signed MSA + SOW and 30% prepayment of the first 3 months at signing. Discounts are conditioned on committed usage not falling below 80% of the committed baseline (true-up quarterly).

Next steps I can action today:
1) Produce a 1-page commercial term sheet with the numbers (DocuSign-ready).
2) Attach SOW annex with the exec escalation clause and runbook outline.
3) Schedule a 30-min working session with your technical lead and our on-call manager to agree runbook details.

If that works, I'll drop the term sheet link (DocuSign) into this thread and loop in legal as needed. Karthik — can you confirm we can absorb the 15% net discount at the $100k band for this account and confirm the Assigned SME pilot availability?

Grace O'Connor
